description.value: A beautifully designed municipal display garden within Fleetwood Park in Surrey's Fleetwood neighbourhood. Features include a large pergola draped in wisteria and clematis, a classically designed knot garden with three varieties of boxwood, and an award-winning perennial border with over 100 varieties. A European-style bosque of 50 red maples adds dramatic structure as the trees mature.
